power.neoorigins.wraith_hunger_drain.des: Maintaining your spectral body is taxing — you exhaust hunger 75% faster than normal.
power.neoorigins.wraith_evolved_phase.de: Toggle: walk through solid blocks with flight while phasing. 25% less hunger drain. Obsidian and bedrock still block you.
power.neoorigins.wraith_ascended_weaknes: Nearby enemies within 3 blocks are afflicted with Weakness.
power.neoorigins.wraith_ascended_dayligh: Sunlight still burns, but with half the intensity.
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_phase.name: Spectral Form (Apex)
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_phase.descr: Toggle: walk through all blocks except bedrock with flight while phasing. Minimal hunger drain. Nothing can contain you.
power.neoorigins.wraith_apex_hunger_drai: Your spectral form has stabilized — hunger drains only 25% faster than normal.
origins.neoorigins.skeleton.name: Ushylagh
origins.neoorigins.skeleton.description: A reanimated bag of bones — tappee, light, and deadly with a bow. Fragile frame, shunned by the sun, and only able to stomach the foulest morsels.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_undead.name: Undead
power.neoorigins.skeleton_undead.descrip: You are undead. Healing potions hurt you, Harming potions heal you, and Smite enchantments deal extra damage to you.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_water_breathin: Does not need to breathe. Can survive indefinitely underwater.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_speed.name: Bone Light
power.neoorigins.skeleton_speed.descript: Your hollow bones make you 20% faster on your feet.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_jump.name: Lightweight
Your fragile bones reduce your max health to 7 hearts.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_daylight_damag: You burn in direct sunlight unless wearing a helmet.
power.neoorigins.skeleton_diet.name: Boneless Diet
power.neoorigins.skeleton_diet.descripti: You can only eat bone meal, rotten flesh, and spider eyes.
Bone meal is edible to you.
origins.neoorigins.slime.name: Glooie
origins.neoorigins.slime.description: A gelatinous being that must stay hydrated to survive. Bounces harmlessly off falls, splits away from death when well-moistened, and grows tougher with experience.
power.neoorigins.slime_moisture.name: Moisture
power.neoorigins.slime_moisture.descript: You have a moisture bar that drains over time. Drains faster in deserts and when on fire. Stand in water or rain to rehydrate. Above 75%: Regen 1. Below 10%: -4 armor. At 0%: you take damage.
power.neoorigins.slime_death_save.name: Split
power.neoorigins.slime_death_save.descri: When you would die with over 75% moisture, you split instead — teleporting 50 blocks away with 2 hearts. Your max HP regenerates back to normal over 2 minutes.
power.neoorigins.slime_level_hp.name: Gelatinous Growth
power.neoorigins.slime_level_hp.descript: +1 max HP per 10 experience levels. Resets on death.
power.neoorigins.slime_no_fall_damage.de: You take no fall damage — you bounce.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_evolved_hp.name: Evolved Vitality
power.neoorigins.abyssal_apex_hp.name: Apex Vitality
power.neoorigins.abyssal_apex_conduit_po: Permanent water breathing, night vision, and Haste — on land and underwater.
